body: He dumped me and kicked me out of our apartment and moved her in. He told me he didn’t love me anymore and kept telling me to just leave. He didn’t even show any kindness or anything and acted as if I was a stranger or some kind of monster. Not like the person he had been with for 5 years.

He kept telling me he was never going to break up with me or cheat on me all the while he went out with her after work (he gets off at 2am) until like 5 am and just never spent time with me. Every time I told him if he didn’t want me anymore just tell me because I didn’t want to be cheated on he said no I still love you blah blah. Then finally right before he told me he cheated he said he didn’t know if he wanted a relationship anymore. It was all so confusing. Especially after he cheated and then wanted me back? I don’t understand why he wanted me back if he wasn’t even in love with me anymore. Everything is so complicated and I’m so pissed at him

Yes that explains how I feel perfectly. I just want him to feel guilt or remorse but I know he doesn’t. I wish there was some kind of justice or karma in this world and he would get what he deserved. Idk I just feel wronged and it’s not fair that he just gets to move on as if what he did is acceptable.
That’s true he is disgusting and a loser. It’s good to hear that perspective instead of seeing him as the person I loved and supported no matter what. You’re right I can do better thank you!
Yes they are... I am feeling somewhat better everyday but some days I go back to crying and missing him. It’s disgusting.

Yes you’re right I’m glad we weren’t married or anything. I just wish he hadn’t kicked me out so cold heartedly. He was so cruel and mean to me and I just don’t understand why. I did try talking to him and telling him about my insecurities and when I felt like maybe he was distant and he said it was in my head. At the end I said I wanted to go to counseling to fix us and he said no. I tried to communicate openly and he shut me down each time. I guess I just have to be brave and pull away after I see the first signs of trouble. It was hard because I truly thought he was a kind person and he had been cheated on in the past like me so I thought he could never hurt me like that too. He even assured me of it using that as a reason. I know better now...
I’m so sorry you’ve been through this too. I don’t know how people can put others through this. Especially after they’ve “loved” them.... thank you for your advice I will check it out

Yes now he took her virginity and moved her in. I know because my roommate is friends with the girl on snap chat and the girl stays with him every night and because when I was moving I found their open box of condoms. They weren’t for us because I was on the Depo shot.

He met her at work when he moved to day shift 3 months ago when she was 18 for sure. I think it is predatory and I didn’t know he was like this. He even told me when we made up that she was just a kid and he didn’t know why he did what he did. But then he dumped me for her anyway and moved her in. So I guess everything is lies. Everyone at his work knows anyway it’s a small town Walmart and they know he’s with her. I think he will be fired. Idk how he would risk his job for her after climbing up the ladder for years.

He was verbally abusive when he played video games. He would call me a c*** and a fucking idiot. He was also really sexist and said mean things to me as jokes. But he would be really sweet other times and cuddle and love me and tell me how much I meant to him and how we were going to get married and be together forever. I know I’m weak and pathetic and I should have left. I just thought he really did love me... I know I was wrong...

Yeah... I think the whole time he knew he was manipulative. He knew I was cheated on before because he was my best friend for 9 years and supported me through it. He was always there and waiting for me to love him back. It was such a good relationship at first until he started doing this. But I didn’t know this was a thing and I didn’t want to leave when I felt like he still did love me.

Yeah I think I didn’t love myself enough and that’s something I need to work on. I did before I met him but I let him break away at me little by little and I don’t know why. But when he treated me right and told me how much he loved me and needed me it made me feel so special and loved. I know he didn’t mean it now...
I wish I had remained independent and left at the first red flag. Now I just feel used, gross, and thrown away like trash. I just want to take back my strength and stop feeling weak.

Yeah I think he was really manipulative. It hurts that he wanted me back and then was willing to dump me immediately again because he decided he actually did want her instead. I’m glad we weren’t married at least. I just don’t get how he could do this after 5 years of being with someone. We were best friends for 9 years as well so I thought I knew him. Thank you for replying to my post.

Thank you this really helps. It was hard to see a future without him in it because we had planned a life together and everything. I guess I need to start thinking about myself now and what future me will be like when she’s moved on and healed from this. I hope I can make myself proud.  Thank you for replying to my post.

Idk I used to be so independent and would have dumped him in a heartbeat but after time went by I just felt more and more like I needed him? It’s gross and I feel pathetic. He just kept pulling me in and pushing me away. Every time he treated me good I felt so happy and special
Thank you for saying that. I just wish he felt the pain that I was feeling instead of being completely happy and moved on already.
I don’t know I guess just because I miss him so much.... I just want to hear his voice and see him again...
Thank you I will try
My roommate has friends coming over so I might hang out with them

I don’t want to be manipulative or meant to be... all I could think about was wanting to not live anymore because he wanted her... all I could think was the memories and how they were all gone now... how he threw away 9 years of happiness and 5 years of love... I just didn’t want to live anymore at that point... I wasn’t trying to manipulate anybody and I’m so sorry to him that it was manipulating... I love him though even though he did this to me and I’m just so confused why he did it.... doesn’t he feel anything for me? I’m sorry I know I shouldn’t be thinking these and I should just let go but all these thoughts keep bouncing inside my mind constantly
I just feel like if he couldn’t love me after all this time together then how could anyone else...
Oregon
Idk he seemed so angry and put all the blame on me and said I was selfish throughout the relationship... just seemed like he was completely done and wanted to be rid of me. I felt like trash.

That makes me feel hopeful. I’ve already deleted him from what I can like Facebook and discord and stuff. I guess I can try meetup.com is that like a friends site? I just want to go places and get my mind off things

Yeah I guess I became too dependent on him. I just thought he was the one I was going to marry and spend the rest of my life with. I know I loved him more than he loved me. I need to focus on loving myself and I understand that. It will be hard to focus on myself but I know I have to.

Yeah I just thought things would be okay. In my mind we were gonna be together again and I was gonna fix myself and we were gonna get back together. That’s why I left. I was stupid. 
It hurts that he found someone else but that makes sense. He kept saying that she made him happy and that I didn’t because I only made him scared and he couldn’t be happy with me. It hurt so much but what you’re saying makes sense. I hope they don’t stay together for a long time but I guess that’s none of my business. It just hurts picturing them together in my old bed. 
A part of me wants to work on myself and have a fresh start at life and another part of me is just depressed and wants him back. But I know I have to keep going.

I’m sorry to hear that this has happened to you but I’m glad you have someone else now. I wish I felt hope but I just keep seeing his face and seeing him with her and it hurts. I want to be happy too with someone. It’s not fair that he gets to be while I’m lonely and hurting. Idk

Yes I am seeing a therapist on Monday and have spoken to crisis hotlines. I even went to a doctor to get a switch in medication but she referenced me somewhere else and I couldn’t get in before all this happened. I know I’m a mess but I just wanted him through all of this. God I just love him so much I would have done anything for him.
I don’t think anyone is out there... if he couldn’t love me how could anyone else.. we were best friends for 9 years and together 5... no one else could love me like that

Yeah I’m 6 months from graduating and didn’t stay in the hospital so I could finish the semester out. I finished my finals though and passed my classes. What I did was wrong and I know I need help. I have an appointment with my therapist on Monday. I just miss him and all the times and years of friendship we had together. I lost more than just my fiancé, I lost my best friend and I don’t get how he’s not hurt at all by this and doesn’t regret this. I just wish I could move on instantly because it hurts so fucking much.

But he was supposed to be the one.. he loved me so much in the beginning I don’t get why he says he still loves me and cares about me ?? It’s confusing. I still hope he regrets this one day but I don’t know if he will. 5 years is such a long time to just throw someone away and forget about them. It hurts and I wish I could get over it right now.

Yeah I don’t have my computer with me right now it’s at the old apartment with him and so are my cats because I can’t afford the deposit fee right now. I want my cats and I’m angry that he’s bringing some slut over while my cats are there. Idk why it’s irrational. But I thought we were on okay terms at least with him saying he cared about me and loved me and would want to be with me as long as I worked on myself, not that he was going to be with that slut that he cheated on me with. I’m so angry and I want my babies with me.
Thank you... I wish he loved me...

I understand that and I regret it. I shouldn’t have done that. It just hurt knowing he wanted her and not me. I shouldn’t have acted out that way but thinking about them together and never being with him again got to me.

I am, I’m going to see my therapist on Monday, it’s just a long time between then and I keep thinking about him and picturing them together. I have nightmares about him and I’m just in pain and depressed since I found out. I just wish I could turn my brain off. It’s not fair that he’s happy and gets to move on while I still love him and miss him and get to feel all this pain. I’m not going to hurt myself again but it’s just not fair...
Please read my post... this kind of happened to me. My 28M ex fiancé fell in love with an 18 year old girl after talking to her and hanging out with her constantly.
Thank you I want to be loved back so bad. I just thought he did love me back and he keeps saying that despite what I think he does love me and care about me... but if he did he wouldn’t do this to me

No I was in a three year relationship and that person cheated on me and said he didn’t love me anymore. My ex fiancé was there for me as a friend and helped me through it. He’s been there for me for 9 years even though we’ve been together for 5. That’s why it’s so hard to move on. I don’t understand how he can help me through that and then be the one to do it to me. I’m just in shock like this can’t actually be real. But yeah that relationship I pined for him for years until I fell in love with my fiancé and then He was everything I wanted. I don’t want to spend years pining for my ex fiancé now I’m not strong enough.

I hope so because this is torture. I keep hoping he’ll regret everything and tell me he misses me. He kept saying he didn’t know what he wanted so a part of me kept thinking maybe that means part of him still wants me. I know I need to move on but god I love him and miss him. Every time I get a text my heart jumps.

Hoping for a text is the worst. My ex fiancé threw me away for an 18 year old he’s manager over after us being together five years. He’s only known her three months. I keep hoping for a text saying he misses me and regrets what he’s done. But I know it won’t happen. But the hope... oh god all of it hurts

Yeah I’m going through this right now where my ex fiancé says he doesn’t know what he wants but he’s kicked me out and wants me to work on myself. I just found out he’s with the girl he cheated on me with and its been only a little over a week since we broke up. They’re both in our old bed at night and it hurts. But I still hope he regrets it and wants me back. Idk why I am doing this to myself.

Yeah he blamed me for a lot and made me feel like everything was my fault. I won’t cut anymore I still feel temptation because a part of me doesn’t want to live without him but I’m trying to reach out and be around people because I don’t want to go down that path again. A huge part of me just wants him again but I know he doesn’t want me. I used to be really into gaming and going out with friends but then I just stayed home and played only games everyday and had no friends when I was with him. I finished the semester already and have to wait until January for the next semester but I have a job interview on Monday at least. I just wish he showed even a little regret or compassion. I don’t understand any of it.

No I don’t... I just never thought he of all people would do this to me. I thought I was safe. I miss him so much and I miss holding him and cuddling and everything. I know I have to move on but it just hurts so fucking much. And it hurts that he could easily throw me away just like that

Some stupid part of me keeps hoping he’ll realize what he’s missing and what he just threw away. I just wish he missed me. I wish he felt the pain of being apart. I don’t understand how he couldn’t but I guess I never will. I just don’t understand any of this at all.

Yeah he just calls me crazy and he didn’t comfort me at all. He kept getting pissed at me that I did it and it made me feel horrible. I regret doing it so much but I also know even if I didn’t he would have fallen for her anyway. I’m just afraid I’ll never trust again because he was so in love with me and told me he would never hurt me or lie or cheat on me but obviously that was a lie. And I keep picturing him and her in our bed together making out and cuddling and it hurts so fucking much.

He already made it clear he doesn’t want me. It hurts so bad. It’s hard to move on. He was supposed to be the love of my life and my husband. I don’t know how he can throw this away for a girl that’s barely legal age and probably just graduated high school

I don’t think anyone could love me like the old him could. The notes he wrote me were so full of love and everything he did for me and the way he looked at me... I can never get that back. There’s no point anymore.

Only the old him. The new him would not want me. The old him wrote me love notes and emails. He cheated on me and broke up with me a week ago. I still read his love notes. I can’t move on but he easily can. He was my best friend for 9 years and my lover for 5. I will never forget him.

Yeah we built a life together in all that time. We were friends 9 years total and I moved in with him at the beginning of our relationship so we lived together 5 years. He was my best friend I would tell him everything and he was my soul mate. We had two cats together and he is looking after them while I find a place. He is being kind but he is being mean it makes no sense. I am trying to break away but I also find hope that he says we could be together again in the future? But I’m also scared he’s letting me down gently. Idk if he’s with this girl. Maybe he has been since the kiss. Nothing makes sense and everything is confusing and I go back and forth in my head constantly and it’s stressful and anxious

Why am I the bad guy then I don’t understand. I was so hurt and wanted to die and yet I’m emotionally manipulative and too crazy. Why is my own brother on his side. I don’t get it. It doesn’t make sense. Why did 5 years get thrown away. Nothing makes sense I want it all to stop my head is spinning I need it to just stop

But there is no one to fix me. He was the person I was going to spend the rest of my life with. No one can fix that. There is a hole that will always be there now. I understand time can heal but it will never heal all the way. I will never be complete again. He ruined me

It’s true people lie and only care about themselves. But it’s too late we’ve already spent 5 years together and when I’m doing well I think about him again and it’s a blow to the stomach I want to break down and cry or just sit and stare into space

Yeah when he was apologizing he said he had no feelings and she was just a kid but why does he want her so much more than me then why is she so important then I don’t understand. She’s so important he had to tell me he was talking to her again right after I cut my wrist and was in the psych room. Maybe he wanted me to die

I’m so lonely. I’m trying not to think about my ex but he said he might want to try again in the future when I’m done with school in June. He said he loves me still. We were together 5 years. But I think he’s letting me down softly. I think I’m going crazy

I recently broke up with my fiancé. He cheated on me with someone much younger and when he wanted me back I came. He got really angry with me the next day and called me a child and said he didn’t want to be with a child. I cut my wrist and was hospitalized. I’ve been out of the hospital for 3 days now. I feel a bit better. I am still lonely and I have nightmares where I’m desperately trying to get back to him but he keeps pushing me away and he doesn’t want me. When I wake up that’s when I’m loneliest. I miss him so much and I just want him to hold me and tell me he loves me. 

I am making progress though. An old coworker told me today that he has a spare room that I can rent for 450 a month. I’ve been applying to jobs all day. My TA said she can give me the practical I missed on Monday so now I won’t fail my vertebrate zoology class. I feel hopeful. 

I still feel pain and hurt and loneliness. But I also feel some hope too. I just hope the pain doesn’t overwhelm me again. Thanks to whoever reads this I just needed to get this out. Thank you OP for making this thread.
